target_customer: Property managers, developers and contractors, starting with multifamily operators
problem: Property accounting teams spend hundreds of hours on invoice coding, card expenses and billbacks, which inflates headcount and delays closes.
business_model: B2B SaaS plus corporate card (card interchange implied, not stated)
product_category: AI accounts payable and corporate cards for real estate

founders.name: Nick Amore
education: Wharton, finance and real estate, minor in computer science
founders.background_notes: YC page says passive real estate investor with 500+ units.

founders.name: Samuel Li
founders.background_notes: YC page says software engineer and tech lead at Rippling on Time Products and Global Payroll.

competitors.name: PredictAP
competitors.what: Invoice ingestion and coding for real estate accounts payable

technical_complexity.rationale: Needs invoice extraction and coding accuracy plus integrations with Yardi, Entrata and Rent Manager and a card program; standard engineering with hard integration parts.

defensibility.rationale: Accounting system integrations and audit data across 100K+ units create stickiness, but PredictAP and general AP tools like Ramp and Bill.com serve the same buyers.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Yardi offers Smart AP inside Yardi Breeze Premier; no action against IronLedger found.

market_need_then: Property managers rely on manual AP coding; vendor sources cite roughly $3 per invoice automated cost and several funded real estate AP tools existed by 2024.

identity.logo: Logo and favicon files offered on the site
identity.voice_and_tone: Direct and benefit focused, for example 'Double your doors, not your headcount'

branding.brand_signature: Tagline: Double your doors, not your headcount

brand_strength.rationale: Clear tagline and customer case studies on the site, but no press about the brand and the .ai domain.

outcome_analysis: IronLedger is an Active Summer 2025 company that its own site says raised $2.5M and has named property management customers across 100,000 plus units, though these are company claims. Founder real estate and Rippling backgrounds fit the product. No exit or distress was found; the open question is displacement of entrenched AP vendors.
notes: The $2.5M raise is stated only on the company's own site; the date is not given (2025 is the batch year) and investors beyond YC are not named, so stage is other. Aggregators (VCBacked, Extruct) show $500K to $1M, which conflicts and is unverified. Samuel Li education not found.
